description: Dept. of Forest Conversation- Forest Conversation Ordinance Order Under Section 3 Wanthibbagoda Forest Reserve
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes a legal/regulatory action. It establishes a new regulatory framework for land use and conservation, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements under existing legislation.
